entries.text: 这里就是新的\n米莫莎的医务室吗？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_first_01

entries.text: 啊，我就知道\n是你叫我来的～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_00

entries.text: 突然被叫来出差，\n真是让我超～惊讶。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_01

entries.text: 而且我是在这边被安排教第一堂课，\n竟然抢在学院前面了呢～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_02

entries.text: 加油！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_select_01

entries.text: 没问题的
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_select_02

entries.text: 瞧你这事不关己的态度……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_03

entries.text: 你那份自信是从哪来的呀！？\n需要自信的人是我啊……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_03b

entries.text: 不过，\n难得你给我这个机会……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_04

entries.text: 米莫莎的医务室，出差版！\n就让我大显身手吧！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp01_05

entries.text: 我把我的第一堂课给搞砸了……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_01

entries.text: 这堂课本身啊，\n上得还是很顺利的哦！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_02

entries.text: 但是我弄错了教室，\n跑到另一个班教了一堂课～！！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_03

entries.text: 那可真惨
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_select_01

entries.text: 这种事难免的！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_select_02

entries.text: 走进正在自习的班里，\n然后擅自上起了健康教育课。\r\n我变成这样的可疑人物了～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_04

entries.text: 不……这不行吧？\n你安慰我，我很开心。\r\n但这种事即使在学院也说不过去吧？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_04b

entries.text: 啊～这事不提了，不提了！\n我一想起来就觉得丢脸！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_05

entries.text: 要忘记讨厌的事，\n吃一堑长一智！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp02_06

entries.text: 我之前不是在其他班里\n上了一堂课吗？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_01

entries.text: 结果那班里有几个学生\n来向我提问了！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_02

entries.text: 对我来说，弄错班级\n是我想要忘记的黑历史。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_03

entries.text: 但是对于那些孩子来说，\n并不是毫无意义的。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_04

entries.text: 我感觉……\n开心得不得了～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_05

entries.text: 太好了！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_select_01

entries.text: 真不得了啊！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_select_02

entries.text: 对吧～确实很好！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_06

entries.text: 当老师果然很开心呀。\n当然有时也会很辛苦就是了。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_07

entries.text: 幸亏我没有放弃梦想。\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]……谢谢你！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_sp03_08

entries.text: 对～了！\n你还有时间吗～？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_01_00

entries.text: 因为你总是很照顾我……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_01_01

entries.text: 所以我们就来交换宝可梦，\n拉近彼此的距离吧～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_01_02

entries.text: OK～\n我会选好坏星，\r\n你要选哪只宝可梦呢？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_01_03

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]啊，不错嘛。
超～有你的风格。\c
既然是我来负责照料，
那就一定会让它健康茁壮地成长！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_01_04

entries.text: 就用你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]和\n我的好坏星交换咯？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_02_00

entries.text: 无法使用初训家不是自己的\n宝可梦进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_02_01

entries.text: 无法使用稀有宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_02_02

entries.text: 无法使用异色宝可梦\n进行交换。
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_02_03

entries.text:
你的同行宝可梦
只有一只啊。
这样是没法交换的。
带２只以上的宝可梦再来吧～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_03_00

entries.text: 咦～你是认真的？\n你拒绝我，可是要吃亏的哦～！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_03_01

entries.text: 你想和我交换宝可梦，\n来拉近彼此的距离了吗～？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_trade_04_00

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，你怎么了？\n难道是想和我对战吗？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_talkto_00

entries.text: 不打了啊！\n算了～也罢。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_cancel_00

entries.text: 反正我有空，可以呀～\n就让我陪陪你吧。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battlestart_00

entries.text: [EMPTY 61]
entries.label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01

entries.text: 小孩子总～是全力以赴，\n真是不得了啊……[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: 尤其是你，也太厉害了，\n稍～微手下留情一点嘛！[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: 既然你战胜了我，\n那我就教你个上相的姿势吧。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: 虽然我觉得这个姿势\n勉强还算不上土……\r\n但用了以后，后果自负哦～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]从米莫莎老师那里\n学会了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]额头比耶动作[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_reward_00

entries.text: 好，做个紧急处理……\n还有这个，你也拿去吧。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: 太拼命可是会受伤的，\n不要太勉强自己哦～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text:
咦？你终～于
学会手下留情了吗？\c
你或许也稍微
长大一点了呢～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text:
你用过
放在巨蛋的回复机吗？\c
可以自己操作来回复哦～
真令我感到怀念啊～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_00

entries.text: 这个学园不是没有医务室吗？\c\n那大家想偷懒的时候\n都去哪里啊？[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
我备课备得
相～当地辛苦啊……\c
学院的老师们
都驾轻就熟，好厉害啊～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_02

entries.text: 你的[VAR 0x0101(0001)]精力太过充沛，\n甚至让我感到头痛！\r\n真是和某人一模一样。[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
我的好坏星很棒吧？
它拥有很罕见的特性。\c
你就好好培育它，
让它登台表演吧～[VAR 0x0114(0028)]
entries.label: coach_teacher_health_randomtalk_04
